title: Banner Effects
description: Addon to Bureau Banners that gives the banners unique effects based on the color.
body:
# Banner Effects
Add-on to [Bureau Banners](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bureau-banners). Adds various effects when wearing banners.

## Key
| Color      | Effect          | Level | Display         |
| ---------- | --------------- | ----- | --------------- |
| red        | strength        | 0     | Strength I      |
| orange     | fire_resistance | 0     | Fire Resistance |
| yellow     | haste           | 0     | Haste I         |
| green      | poison          | 0     | Poison I        |
| lime       | jump_boost      | 0     | Jump Boost I    |
| cyan       | night_vision    | 0     | Night Vision    |
| blue       | water_breathing | 0     | Water Breathing |
| light_blue | speed           | 0     | Swiftness I     |
| purple     | none            | 0     |                 |
| magenta    | none            | 0     |                 |
| pink       | regeneration    | 0     | Regeneration I  |
| brown      | nausea          | 0     | Nausea          |
| white      | glowing         | 0     | Glowing         |
| gray       | slow_falling    | 0     | Slow Falling    |
| dark_gray  | resistance      | 0     | Resistance I    |
| black      | blindness       | 0     | Blindness       |

## Installation
Add both [Bureau Banners](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bureau-banners) and this to the world datapacks folder.

## Notes
- If the datapack is uninstalled, the banners that were made wearable will remain wearable.
- Bureau Banners is *not* required for this to work, but players will not be able to wear the banners without commands.

[Sixteenths](https://sixteenths.org) for the idea.
